name: Beam sensor
description: A light receiver that turns on once a beam at or above its threshold has been held on it for the dwell time, and off when the light goes. Half a metre up, at the height of the mirror and lens stands.

threshold.description: Intensity at or above which light counts.

dwellSeconds.description: Seconds the light must be held before it turns on.

mode.description: momentary goes off with the light; latching until reset.

inputs.name: beam
inputs.description: A light beam reaching the sensor.

outputs.name: lit
outputs.description: On while enough light has been held on the sensor.
